caption: The drawing features a wooden cradle with rocking legs, depicted in a three-quarter perspective against a plain, light beige background. The cradle is predominantly brown, with a lighter wooden tone for the body and darker curved rockers beneath. The surface of the cradle is decorated with small painted details, including floral designs with pink and green colors on the exterior side panel and end panel, along with some green leafy patterns on the rocker. The interior headboard of the cradle shows miniature painted scenes with tiny objects, such as pairs of shoes or small bottles, as well as a small painted plaque with text. There are two oval-shaped handholds cut out on the side panels, and the top edges of the cradle are curved with scalloped detailing. The drawing is signed “L. Plogsted” in the bottom right corner.
title: Cradle
